greedy.text:
Quarterly Engineering Report

The native OCR engine converts scanned pages into Markdown for language model workflows. It runs a vision transformer and a compact decoder on MLX.

Key results
1. Latency is measured per page at 144 dpi.
2. Output text matches the reference decoder.
3. Weights load once per process.

文档解析将扫描页面转换为结构化文本。

Contact: platform team, building 7, room 210.
